newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU opens probe into French aid to Thomson.
newsitem.headline: EU opens probe into French aid to Thomson.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had opened a formal probe into French state aid to Thomson SA consumer electronics unit Thomson multimedia.
It said in a statement it was looking at a capital injection of some 11 billion French francs that the parent company had received as recapitalisation.
The Commission said it was also looking at the French proposal to buy Thomson's stake in Credit Lyonnais which was likely to include overvaluing which could amount to state aid.
